correctness.rationale: An explicit Hilbert–Schmidt Gram factorization gives positivity, finite trace and nonzero spectral correspondence. A unitary scaling supplies S_q exactly. Rank-one trace-class integrals give K, and the harmonic-number cumulative discrepancy has 0<D<=1/q and |qD-gamma|<=4 exp(-qv). The nuclear derivative bound integrates to the stated O(q^-2) remainder and sharp first-order coefficient. Standard compact self-adjoint spectral perturbation completes the eigenvalue consequences; no finite computation is used as proof.

value.rationale: The natural q-dependent gamma Helson matrix approaches the critical moment boundary while becoming trace-small; its renormalization has a nontrivial compact weighted Carleman spectral law. An explicit summable whole-spectrum error, sharp first-order rank-one trace-norm correction, and a positive top-eigenvalue shift provide exact structural information beyond trace-class membership, a fixed trace, or a finite sample of eigenvalues.
